Here is a Python script that installs an SSH server on a target Windows machine without relying on anything from the web and ensuring a safe installation:

```python
import subprocess

# Define the path to the OpenSSH installer
openssh_installer = "C:\\path\\to\\OpenSSH\\OpenSSH-Install.ps1"

# Run the OpenSSH installer script
subprocess.run(['powershell.exe', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', openssh_installer])

print("SSH server installation complete.")
```

Make sure to replace `"C:\\path\\to\\OpenSSH\\OpenSSH-Install.ps1"` with the actual path to the OpenSSH installer script on the Windows machine.

You can save this script in a `.py` file and execute it on the target Windows machine using Python. This script will run the OpenSSH installer script silently and install the SSH server securely without relying on anything from the web.
